name: WBN Image Optimizer Lite
author: atircohen

sections.description:
Faster Images. Safe Originals.

WBN Image Optimizer Lite helps you optimize your WordPress images with modern formats like WebP and AVIF, reducing file sizes by 50-80% while maintaining visual quality.

Key Features

  • WebP & AVIF Conversion – Convert images to modern formats with significantly smaller file sizes
  • Automatic Backups – Every original is automatically backed up before optimization
  • Smart Presets – Pre-configured settings for products, banners, galleries, and thumbnails
  • Bulk Operations – Process multiple images at once
  • Manual Control – Full control over quality, dimensions, and format
  • Unlimited Optimizations – No monthly limits in Lite version
  • Safe & Reversible – Restore originals anytime with one click

How It Works

  1. Select images from your Media Library
  2. Choose a preset or customize settings
  3. Click Optimize – backups are created automatically
  4. Enjoy faster loading times and better PageSpeed scores

Smart Presets

  • Products – 1200×1600px, WebP, Quality 82 (Perfect for WooCommerce)
  • Banners – 1920×1080px, AVIF, Quality 75 (Hero images and sliders)
  • Gallery – 1600×1600px, WebP, Quality 80 (Photo galleries)
  • Thumbnails – 400×400px, WebP, Quality 85 (Small images)

What’s Different in Pro?

The Pro version adds:
* Unused Image Scanner – Find and safely delete images not used on your site
* Advanced Statistics – Detailed optimization reports
* Priority Support – Direct support from our team
* Automatic Updates – Get new features first

Upgrade to Pro →

Technical Details

  • Supports JPG, PNG, and GIF input formats
  • Outputs JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF
  • Automatic fallback if AVIF is not supported
  • Integrates with WordPress Media Library
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Multisite compatible
  • RTL ready

Privacy Policy

WBN Image Optimizer Lite does not:
* Collect any personal data
* Track user behavior
* Send data to external servers
* Use cookies
* Store IP addresses

All image processing happens locally on your server.

Support

  • Documentation: https://webnest.co.il/docs/wbn-image-optimizer/
  • Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/wbn-image-optimizer-lite/
  • Pro Support: https://webnest.co.il/support/

Credits

Developed by WebNest – Professional WordPress Solutions
https://webnest.co.il/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “WBN Image Optimizer Lite”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

After Activation

  1. Go to Image Optimizer in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Click “Select Images” to choose images from your Media Library
  3. Choose a preset or customize settings
  4. Click “Optimize Selected Images”
  5. Wait for processing to complete
sections.faq:
Is this really free?

Yes! The Lite version is completely free with unlimited optimizations. The Pro version adds advanced features like the unused image scanner.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes! WBN Image Optimizer works with any WordPress theme. It optimizes images in your Media Library.

Are my original images safe?

Absolutely! Every image is automatically backed up before optimization. You can restore originals anytime.

What’s the difference between WebP and AVIF?

WebP is widely supported and provides 60-70% file size reduction. AVIF is newer, provides up to 80% reduction, but has less browser support. Both are safe to use as WordPress provides automatic fallbacks.

Can I optimize existing images?

Yes! Use the “Select Images” button to choose any images from your Media Library and optimize them.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The presets are optimized for product images and the plugin works perfectly with WooCommerce galleries.

How do I restore original images?

Currently in development. For now, originals are safely backed up in wp-content/uploads/wbio-backups/.

Can I use this on multiple sites?

Yes! The Lite version can be used on unlimited sites. Pro version includes licensing for 1-5 sites depending on plan.

Will this slow down my site?

No! Optimization happens in the background and doesn’t affect your site’s frontend performance.

What if I need help?

  • Check our documentation at webnest.co.il
  • Post in the WordPress.org support forum
  • Pro users get priority email support
